component.name: Super Productivity
component.summary: To-do list & time tracker for programmers and other digital workers with Jira, Github, and Gitlab integration

description.h1: 🚀 Boost Your Productivity with the Ultimate To-Do & Time Management App! 🚀
description.h2: 🕐 Organize Tasks, Track Time, and Manage Your Todo List
description.p: Effortlessly manage your todo list and track time spent on each task using advanced timeboxing techniques. Stay focused, prevent burnout, and keep your projects on track. Generate detailed timesheets and summaries for efficient work documentation.
Stay in control by integrating with Jira, GitHub, GitLab, OpenProject, and more. Track critical updates without being overwhelmed by notifications and filter what matters most to stay organized.
Customize your workflow with powerful productivity helpers, including:
description.h2: 📅 Plan Your Day with Calendar Integration
description.p: Turn your calendar events into actionable tasks and use the planner feature to visualize your day. Quickly organize your tasks and ensure nothing slips through the cracks.
Your data is yours. This app collects no data, requires no accounts, and ensures total privacy. It's a free and always will be!
